insights.summary: Offline conversions reach Google Ads two to three days after the call, so Smart Bidding swings on stale data; CPA up from ~$85 to ~$120.
insights.quote: the offline conversions are showing up two, sometimes three days after the call

insights.summary: CallRail is pitching same-day conversion sync to Google Ads.
insights.quote: CallRail's been emailing me, like, every week. Their rep keeps telling me they push conversions to Google same day.

insights.summary: Signal AI tags after-hours callers as spam; 31 of 40 sampled were real customers booking jobs.
insights.quote: Signal AI is tagging a lot of our after-hours calls as spam, and they're not spam.

insights.summary: Finance asks why PreSense is an add-on ahead of renewal: "feels like paying twice."
insights.quote: he asked me why PreSense is an add-on at all. His words were, it feels like paying twice.

insights.summary: Dispatchers love AI call summaries; saves each about an hour a day.
insights.quote: the dispatchers love them. Like, genuinely.

insights.summary: Hedged: if the Google Ads delay is not fixed by renewal they will look at alternatives.
insights.quote: if the Google piece isn't fixed by renewal, we'll have to look around.
